$description: AgentOS Design System Popover component spec — Ant Design popover trigger with elevated content card for the local Figma library

layers.name: trigger
layers.role: trigger container — background, border, radius, padding, height

layers.name: overlay
layers.role: floating popover wrapper shown for State=Open

layers.name: arrowSlot
layers.role: transparent holder that positions the arrow above the card

layers.name: arrow
layers.role: diamond arrow that inherits the overlay fill

layers.name: card
layers.role: vertical elevated surface for title, body, and optional footer actions

content.antd: content prop represented as either descriptive text only or text plus actions

state.antd: open maps to visible popup; closed and hover are design-time trigger previews

titleMinWidth.reason: Ant Design Popover token titleMinWidth is not a local Vision Token variable.

cardWidth.reason: Overlay width depends on content and is kept as a local component constant.

arrowSize.reason: Arrow geometry is component-specific and not modeled as a shared token.

overlayOffsetY.reason: Trigger-to-overlay placement is a local composition constant.

shadow.reason: Local file lacks a dedicated Popover overlay shadow; reuse the existing subtle system shadow.

notes.scope: v1 models the trigger plus a representative content card with optional title and optional footer actions. Placement, auto shift, keyboard treatment, and custom arrow configs remain follow-up work.
notes.state: State=Open keeps the card visible. State=Closed and State=Hover keep the overlay hidden and only preview trigger styling.
notes.content: Content=Info represents a pure informational popover. Content=Action adds a divider and two inline actions to reflect Ant Design guidance that Popover may include operations.

figmaConventions.variableMode: Never set explicit Light/Dark mode on component appearance — inherit from file or page context.
figmaConventions.pageContent: Component pages contain only component sets — no text labels, showcase matrices, doc frames, or instance grids.

BodyText.default: This is a lightweight container for supplementary information and follow-up actions.

figmaConventions.variantLayout: State columns horizontally, Content rows grouped vertically inside each Title block.

gaps.name: placementVariants
gaps.reason: Top, left, right, and corner placements are intentionally excluded from v1 to keep the component set compact.

gaps.name: overlayShadowToken
gaps.reason: No dedicated overlay effect style exists in the local file yet, so the component reuses the existing subtle button shadow.

gaps.name: arrowVisibilityAxis
gaps.reason: Arrow is fixed on in v1 and not promoted to a separate variant axis.
